title: Pipeline samplesheet schema
description: Schema for validating pipeline samplesheet with support for illumina, pacbio, nanopore, and hybrid data

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens

R1.errorMessage: R1 must be empty or a valid FASTQ file (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz, .fastq.gz)

R2.errorMessage: R2 must be empty or a valid FASTQ file (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz, .fastq.gz)

LReads.errorMessage: LReads must be empty or a valid BAM/FASTQ file (.bam, .fq, .fastq, .fq.gz, .fastq.gz)
